forbidden_unreachable_proof: The handler's 403 needs view=True AND manage=False (views/runner.py:48-51). view=True requires visibility==PRIVATE and owner (permissions.py:74-75); manage on PRIVATE+owner returns True (permissions.py:135-136). No input satisfies both — the 403 is unreachable today. Recorded and ported anyway per issue: the port keeps the view-then-manage order and the {"error": "forbidden"} body so a future visibility value cannot silently open or mislabel access.
